title: Arm Wrestle!
description: Verse a non player in an arm wrestle. Anyone can win.\n\nFilm it if they consent.

title: Honk Hunt
description: Get any vehicle to honk their horn.

title: Hickery Dickery Dock
description:
Find the closest analogue clock and sing the nursery rhyme "Hickery Dickery Dock".

You must record video evidence to claim your band.

The lyrics are as follows:

Hickory dickory dock
The sheep hid from its flock
The flock called once
The sheep did run
Hickory dickory dock
Hickory dickory dock
The sheep hid from its flock
The flock called twice
And that was nice!
Hickory dickory dock
Hickory dickory dock
The sheep hid from its flock
The flock called thrice
And that was wise
Hickory dickory dock

title: Business Card Rush
description:
Collect business cards from different locations or people. You have 5 minutes from now to find the first card.

The timer resets to 5 minutes every time you find another card.

The challenge is over when your timer ends. The challenge is vetoed if you find no cards.

You receive 1 band per card.

Your time starts now!

title: Instant Veto!
description:
UH OH!

This challenge is an instant veto. You must wait 8 minutes before scanning or participating in another challenge.

Sometimes that's the risk you take…

title: Do You Know The Muffin Man?
description:
You must call out "Do yOu kNoW tHe MuFfIn MaN?".

You must get a non-player to respond with one of the following:
- "Who lives on Drury Lane?"
- "The muffin man?"

Please film only yourself while you attempt this challenge.

title: Loop de Loop
description: Take any form of public transport for at least one stop. Return to the node location you're currently at.\n\nYou may only receive your band when you return to this location.

title: Photo Recreation?
description: Find at least 2 teammates (3 people total) and recreate this photo.\n\nEach participating player receives a band.

title: Leap Frog Relay!
description:
Find at least 2 teammates to play leap frog.

Everyone must leap over each other at least twice. Provide video evidence.

All participating players receive a band.

title: Crab Walk!
description: Crab walk to the nearest bench including crab hands. Provide video footage.\n\nYou don't need to do crab hands with the hand you use to film yourself.

title: Time For A Fit Check
description: Find the nearest clothing store that is having a sale. You have 6 minutes from when you enter the store to put an outfit together and model it.\n\nYou do not need to purchase it. Make a short video advertising your get up.

title: Human Pyramid!
description:
Find at least 2 teammates and make a human pyramid.

Each participant gets a band.

You must film your attempt.

title: Dizzy Dash
description: Spin around as fast as you can for 20 seconds and then run to the nearest street pole that's at least 10m away and back.\n\nYou must film your attempt from your POV.

title: Wake Up Jeff!
description:
You may NOT read this challenge aloud. You may NOT tell anyone you have pulled this challenge!

Pretend to be sleeping. This can be done in any position that is safe and comfortable. A teammate must physically touch you to wake you up without being prompted by you.

Each player involved gets a band.

title: Lonely Statue
description:
Pick a location and stand like a statue with your hand out waiting for a high-five.

You may not use your phone for anything other than a timer during this challenge.

You must stand in that position for 8 minutes. You may take a band and stop standing in that position only if a non-player high-fives you.

You do NOT have to wait another 8 minutes as a veto period if you don't get a high-five. You have already served the veto period. And you got rejected by everyone around you... Ouch...

Your time starts now!

title: Spelling Bee Shootout
description:
Find 2 teammates for a Spelling Bee Shootout.

Each teammate may attempt each word once. You may Google a word if you don't know it. You may use it in a sentence if the contestants request it.

Between the two of them they must correctly spell 3 of these 5 words exactly as they are spelled here:
Accommodate
Their
Mourning
Mussel
Leisure

All participating players get a band if they succeed. The challenge is vetoed if they fail.

title: Cairn You Stack 'Em?
description:
You must create a single stack of rocks using rocks found nearby.

You must stack at least 3 rocks in order to not veto this challenge.

You receive bands depending on how many rocks you can stack:
3 Rocks = 1 Band
6 Rocks = 2 Bands
9+ Rocks = 3 Bands

You have 5 minutes. Your time starts right now!
